summary: Tsakos Energy Navigation Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 22, 2026, attaching a May 21 press release on Q1 2026 unaudited results. The release reports net income of $89M ($2.72 per share), revenues of $253M, and declares a $1.00 semi-annual dividend, a 36% increase from prior year. It also mentions a scheduled vessel repurchase of two tankers at below-market prices and charter extensions. These are ordinary operational and capital allocation updates, not a transformative special situation. The filing is a routine earnings report, fitting no special-situations category.
